tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registration Certificate of the participating firm/agency/organization
Registration Certificate: Bidder/firm shall be registered in the Karnataka e-governance portal with a valid digital signature certificate

MSME Certificate/Udyam Registration Shall be registered for Manufacturing as Major activity with NIC code(s) wholesale of straw, Dry Fodder & other animal/poultry feed Trading activity and shall be registered within karnataka state as official address to claim 15% price preference in bid evaluation. If Udyam certificate fails to meet the criteria mentioned above, it shall be deemed invalid
Last 2 years income tax filing and GST filing document of the participating firm
A certificate issued by the competent authority showing an average annual turnover not less than of Rs.12.00 lakhs in the last two years
PAN card and Aadhar Card of the participating proprietor/Partnership firm
GST Certificate of the participating firm

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other required documents has to be uploaded as per tender documents
